subject: ClearPass demo — exec conflict; options to compress or reschedule
messages:
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah@clearpass.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@clearpass.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — potential conflict

Hi Dylan,

Quick note — our CFO (Daniel) has a last-minute board prep that overlaps the 11:00–12:00 PDT slot we had confirmed for Thursday.

Would you be able to either:
- compress the walkthrough to a 30-minute exec-focused run (we mostly want pricing + high-level throughput and reliability numbers), or
- move to Friday morning (preferred) or next Tuesday?

Apologies for the churn — we're still very keen to see the platform. Attaching a short internal agenda.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Head of Platform Partnerships | ClearPass Inc
Attachment: internal-agenda-CLP.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah@clearpass.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — potential conflict

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — totally understandable. Two immediate options from our side:

1) Compress to a 30-minute exec run (we'll focus on pricing, SLA + latency numbers, and a 5-minute live token gen demo). Karthik will highlight typical latency/cost tradeoffs at a high level. We can follow with a separate 45–60m technical deep-dive for engineers. I attached a proposed 30m agenda.

2) Move to Friday 9/10 at 10:00–11:00 PDT or next Tuesday 9/14 in the morning (we can offer 9:30–10:30 PDT).

Karthik — quick callout: are you on travel that week? If unavailable, Marissa can run the exec-focused session with me.

Sarah — which would you prefer? If compressing, we'll send an abbreviated deck and record the session.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-agenda-30m.md (text/markdown)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — potential conflict

Heads-up — I'm on an all-day travel day Thursday (red-eye to London) and won't be reliable for live demos until Friday afternoon PDT. I can do the 30-minute exec session at 11:00 PDT on Friday if that's the only slot, but I'd prefer Marissa to take the exec walk on Friday morning.

If you go with the compressed 30m option, I suggest the following split:
- 0–5m: quick intros + objectives (Dylan)
- 5–20m: exec-focused demo (Marissa) — key metrics, reliability story, routing/fallbacks
- 20–28m: pricing + cost levers (Dylan)
- 28–30m: wrap + next steps

I'll volunteer to run the separate technical follow-up (45–60m) next week and can prep a short kernel selection/quantization slide for the tech team.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
